coder_notes: Lerapolturev (PVSRIPO) is an oncolytic poliovirus -> excluded_intervention_type; pembrolizumab is the only pharmacological investigational agent (cf. manual example pembrolizumab + vaccine). A trivalent inactivated poliovirus vaccine (IPOL) boost before lerapolturev is required in eligibility but is not a registered intervention; not listed as an agent. MGMT appears only in the description of prior first-line therapy, not as an entry requirement, so no biomarker row. Lead sponsor Istari Oncology is a company (captured by [CODE] sponsor class); no separate text statement of drug supply.
